exposure: Knowledge of manual rotation for persistent occiput posterior position
Experience with manual rotation for persistent occiput posterior position
outcome: Knowledge and experience of midwives and gynecologists regarding manual rotation for persistent occiput posterior position
finding: The majority of midwives and gynecologists had limited information about manual rotation for persistent occiput posterior position and had never performed it, but most expressed a desire to learn and perform the technique if it was recognized as safe and included in national protocols.
